rules.statement: A Viharadhipati is the principal bhikkhu of a temple, who need not be resident in the temple, and this role is equivalent to the incumbent before 1931.
rules.supporting_quote: "Instead of the words 'the chief' in the earlier definitions of 'incumbent' the definition of 'Viharadhipati' contains the words 'the principal' and the only other change effected is that a Bhikkhu could be a Viharadhipati whether he was resident in the temple or not-a change which was probably made because a priest can be an incumbent of more than one temple."
